text.en: Stonebridge Hall. I was hoping for something quieter than a fight.
text.zh-CN: 石桥会馆。我还盼着，这次能遇到点比打架安静的事。

text.en: We've made it through your guards. Can we discuss returning the gold now?
text.zh-CN: 我们已经闯过了守卫。现在，能谈谈归还黄金的事了吗？

text.en: Yes. Once we've settled two small matters.
text.zh-CN: 可以。不过，先把两件小事说清楚。

text.en: I weigh hearts for a living. I can listen to two complaints.
text.zh-CN: 我平时做的就是衡量人心。听两句意见，倒也不难。

text.en: First, respect the hall's rules. We don't hand a guarded chest to anyone who shouts loud enough.
text.zh-CN: 第一，遵守会馆的规矩。谁的声音大，就把看管的箱子交给谁，那可不行。

text.en: Then let a witness speak for the owners. Hathor has come all this way for them.
text.zh-CN: 那就让证人替失主说话。哈索尔正是为他们一路找到这里的。

text.en: Second, Horus stays until we're sure he can get it safely home.
text.zh-CN: 第二，要确认荷鲁斯能把东西安全送回去，才能让他离开。

text.en: You can test him. Keeping him fed while you decide will cost you more than the chest.
text.zh-CN: 你们尽管考验他。要是一直犹豫，光是留他吃饭，就得比这箱东西花得还多。

text.en: You think you've understood our formation? Step inside and prove it.
text.zh-CN: 你们以为已经看懂阵势了？那就进来证明给我们看。

text.en: Gladly. Show me the whole defense this time.
text.zh-CN: 好。这次就让我看看，完整的守卫阵势。

text.en: As you wish. Everyone, take your positions.
Thank you. I'll leave Hathor and Anubis to argue over the receipts.
text.zh-CN: 多谢。收据的事，就留给哈索尔和阿努比斯商量吧。

text.en: Horus. Glad I found you before you challenged the furniture, too.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯。还好赶上了，免得你连这里的家具也要挑战一遍。

text.en: About that duel at the ferry... I owe you an apology.
text.zh-CN: 渡口那场决斗……我还欠你一句道歉。

text.en: Call it a bad introduction. Where next?
text.zh-CN: 就当是开场没打好招呼吧。接下来去哪儿？

text.en: Highbridge. There's a teacher I need to find.
text.zh-CN: 高桥城。我得去找一位老师。

text.en: We're heading that way. Travel with us; we could use someone who stands up for his friends.
text.zh-CN: 我们也往那边走。一起吧，我们正需要会替朋友出头的同行者。

text.en: All right. These fighting notes should help on the road.
text.zh-CN: 好。这份战技笔记，在路上应该能帮上忙。
